responsibility: Declares ProcMacroInvocLexer, the parser-facing token-source wrapper used specifically for procedural macro token streams. It extends the generic macro-invocation lexer base over const tokens and exposes lookahead plus token-splitting operations needed to reparse proc-macro output accurately, especially where punctuation tokens must be decomposed before normal Rust parsing continues.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ProcMacroInvocLexer wrapper specialized for procedural-macro token streams and exposes its peek and token-splitting operations. Unlike the paired implementation file, it defines the lexer adapter’s interface, not the concrete mechanics for EOF synthesis and token rewriting.
